AdamCo Demo — About AdamCo Demo Home Projects Tickets Settings Docs About About this demo AdamCo is a synthetic SaaS application used as the standards-first target for the Agent Web Graph crawler prototype. It is hand-built to expose: HTML popover (user menu) <dialog> with command="show-modal" (sign out, new ticket, delete workspace) Custom Invoker Commands (command="--toggle-theme") ARIA tabs (Recent / Popular / Archived) ARIA combobox + listbox (docs search) A sidecar design-tokens.json with a tokens.json reference A sidecar webmcp.json declaring three capabilities across tiers Every page in this demo is a 200 OK anonymous response. The crawler exercises the full five-layer extraction against this surface and writes the result to a single Graph document.
